title: FeatherFly
description: Fly High with Feathers in survival!
body:

# **FeatherFly**
Tired of trudging across your Minecraft Survival world on foot? FeatherFly is here to lift you up, literally! Harness the magical power of feathers to take flight and soar like a majestic bird. Collect feathers and fuel your aerial adventures until your supply runs dry. But don't worry; the cushioned landing system kicks in if you ever run out. You'll experience a gentle, slowed descent with feather falling!

## Key Features:
- **Magical Flight Powered by Feathers**:
Activate your very own flight mode by spending your hard-earned feathers. Enjoy the thrill of gliding through the skies on a feather-fueled adventure!
- **FeatherBoost**:
Right-click on a feather in your hotbar to gain a 10-second speed boost, doubling your flight speed at the cost of a feather!
- **Cushioned Fall Damage** **(optional)**:
When you stop flying, FeatherFly smartly calculates your drop to ensure you land with style. With an extra block of safety built in, you take significantly less fall damage so you can keep the adventure going!
- **Customizable Flight Speeds per World**:
Your server, your rules! Set custom flight speeds for each world via simple configuration options. Whether you're exploring the Overworld, Nether, or even custom realms, your flight experience adapts to every environment.
- **Fun Particle Trails**:
Leave a magical trail of particles in your wake as you fly, making every flight a visually stunning experience.
## Commands:
- **/ffly**: Toggles flight.
- **/featherfly reload**: reloads config.
- **/ffly particles**: change particles.
## Permissions:
- **ffly.use**:
description: Allows use of /ffly
default: op
- **featherfly.admin**:
description: Allows reloading of the FeatherFly plugin configuration.
default: op
- **ffly.particle**:
description: Allows changing the FeatherFly particle trail via /ffly particle.
default: op
